bugs.error_message: TS2430: Interface 'ApiProduct' incorrectly extends interface 'Partial<Omit<Product, "id">>'. Types of property 'images' are incompatible. Type 'ProductImage[]' is not assignable to type 'string[]'.
bugs.root_cause: ApiProduct extends Partial<Omit<Product, 'id'>> and separately redeclares its own `images?: ProductImage[]` (the raw wire shape) — but Product.images is `string[]` (the normalized shape), so the redeclaration conflicts with the inherited property type.
bugs.fix: Changed to `Partial<Omit<Product, 'id' | 'images'>>` so the raw `images` field isn't inherited from Product in the first place.

bugs.error_message: Selecting a heavier/lighter size variant on ProductDetail showed the correct variant price in the cart, but checkout charged based on the product's base weight instead
bugs.root_cause: ProductDetail.tsx's handleAddToCart already baked the selected variant's weight+price into the cart item, but Payment.tsx's three checkout item-mapping call sites (create-order, verify-razorpay, verify-COD) only sent {product, quantity} to the backend — never item.weight. The backend pricing.service.ts already supported a per-line weight/variantWeight override (computeCheckout -> parseWeight(raw.variantWeight ?? raw.weight)), so it silently fell back to the product's base weight, both when creating the Razorpay order and when verifying it (so the amount-match check never caught the discrepancy — both sides used the same wrong weight).
bugs.fix: Added `weight: item.weight` to all three items.map(...) call sites in Payment.tsx and to RazorpayOrderPayload.items / PaymentVerificationPayload.orderData.items in payment.ts. Added kv-api/src/tests/pricing.service.test.ts 'computeCheckout — variant weight passthrough' to regression-test the full contract.

bugs.error_message: Product-owner audit: logging in as staff and opening /admin produced 30 console errors (403 Forbidden) across nearly every tab — dashboard stats, orders, customers, savings, coupons, returns, inventory, shipping
bugs.file: src/pages/Admin.tsx (frontend enabled staff for these queries; root cause was backend kv-api/src/routes/admin.routes.ts)
bugs.root_cause: Admin.tsx's queries were already `enabled: role==='admin'||'staff'` for most tabs (the frontend was built assuming staff access), but the backend's admin.routes.ts blanket-required isAdmin for the whole router. Browser-verified via Playwright with the seeded staff@kvsilverzone.com account.
bugs.fix: Backend fixed (see kv-api buglog bug-090) to allow staff on all these routes except inventory (user decision: staff mirrors admin except inventory). Frontend: inventory queries (`admin-inventory-transactions`, `admin-inventory-low-stock`, `admin-inventory-summary`) changed to `enabled: role === 'admin'` only, Inventory TabsTrigger hidden behind `!isStaffOnly`, and the inventory tab added to a new `ADMIN_ONLY_TABS` list so a staff user hitting `/admin/inventory` directly redirects to `/admin/dashboard`.

bugs.error_message: Admin panel tabs had no individual URLs — /admin always showed whichever tab was last clicked in local state; no deep links, no bookmarking, no browser back/forward between tabs
bugs.root_cause: Radix `Tabs` was uncontrolled (`defaultValue="dashboard"`) and App.tsx mounted Admin at the single flat path `/admin`.
bugs.fix: App.tsx route changed to `path="/admin/*"`. Admin.tsx reads the splat segment via `useParams()['*']` as the active tab (falls back to 'dashboard'), and `Tabs`' `onValueChange` calls `navigate(/admin/${value})`. Added `ADMIN_TABS`/`ADMIN_ONLY_TABS` validation: an unknown tab segment, or a staff user hitting an admin-only tab's URL directly (theme, inventory), redirects to `/admin/dashboard`. Verified live via Playwright: deep links, tab-click URL sync, back/forward, and both redirect cases.
